originalUserContext.source: Original human wording supplied by the parent, corroborated by docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-10-cross-platform-delivery-design.md

originalThreeRequirements.humanText: 网络检查：用户可以选择间隔时间（比如每半个小时），检查一次网络。
originalThreeRequirements.implementation: Main-process scheduling; default disabled and 30 minutes, integer 1–1440 minute choices; immediate check on enable, persistent settings and cancellation-safe cadence.
originalThreeRequirements.verificationScope: Existing controlled-clock core acceptance proves cadence and cancellation. Actual packaged desktop evidence proves settings/UI persistence, including 17 minutes; it is not a claim that every interval was waited out in real time.

originalThreeRequirements.humanText: 自动修复：如果网络有问题，就自动去修复。
originalThreeRequirements.implementation: Confirmed fault initiates a bounded repair session; DNS/HTTP, stale local proxy and missing address/route select fixed actions. Static IP, working proxy, authorization errors and uncertain cleanup are protected.
originalThreeRequirements.verificationScope: Fixed native RPC, read-only checks, helper authentication and DNS cache actions have actual platform evidence; exceptional and restoration behavior also uses isolated fixtures. No user network adapter reconfiguration is claimed.

originalThreeRequirements.humanText: 超时处理：如果修复失败，且修复时间超过 5 分钟，默认是无动作。但是用户也可以选择开启，在超过 5 分钟之后给电脑自动重启。
originalThreeRequirements.implementation: Five-minute deadline stops the repair session with no default reboot. Restart is separately confirmed, permission-checked, rechecked before countdown and dispatch, cancellable for 60 seconds, and guarded against stale callbacks/reboot loops. Login startup is separately optional and defaults off.
originalThreeRequirements.verificationScope: Timeout/restart/cancel/loop behavior is tested with controlled clocks and fixed platform fixtures. No real computer reboot was performed or required as an acceptance side effect.
